messages:
maria: Heads up — alert from our traces SLA: sampling for service-x dropped dramatically after we bumped opentelemetry SDK. Parent spans exist but most child spans are missing. Dash: https://dashboards.redwood/services/service-x/traces Logs: https://logs.redwood/service-x :eyes:

sam: Which SDK and which PR? did the sampler config change?

maria: opentelemetry-python 1.18 -> 1.19 in PR https://git/repo/pull/482. I checked the k8s configmap: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.01 (we expected 0.1). Not sure if that was intentional.

jonas: that 0.01 looks suspect. Check infra helm values: infra/helm/service-x/values.yaml has sampler.rate: 0.01 ?

li: also note prefetcher runs as a separate deployment and may inherit a different set of env vars. Run: `kubectl -n prod get deploy svc-x-prefetch -o yaml | grep -i OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` to confirm.

maria: did the check — prefetcher had no explicit OTEL env, so it fell back to SDK default (which is 0.01 after the bump). That explains why most child spans are missing for batch workers.

deploy-bot: CI build for PR #482 passed :white_check_mark: — canary image pushed.

sam: quick remediation: propose a tiny change to set sampler arg to 0.1 in the helm chart and redeploy canary with 2 replicas. I can open the PR.

maria: please do — ping @jonas and @li for review. Also we should tweak alerts: current trace-sla alert fires at <0.5% over 5m; given sampling noise during deployment maybe raise to <2% and add an annotation about sampler config changes.

jonas: agree. I'll prep an alerts PR after the chart fix. For immediate debugging you can search trace ids in Honeycomb: `dataset:service-x where span.name=\"http.client\" and !has(span.parent)` and inspect a few traces to confirm child span absence.

li: FYI we correlated this with a small spike in outbound 429s earlier — logs: https://logs.redwood/service-x?query=429 sample line: `{\"time\":\"2026-03-16T14:12:03Z\",\"trace_id\":\"abc123\",\"span\":\"http.client\",\"status\":\"OK\"}`

maria: thanks. Sam — can you include a brief runbook note in the PR about where to look (dashboards + kubectl check) and mention potential cost/ingest impact? :+1:

sam: yep opening PR now: https://git/repo/pull/489 — title: \"helm(service-x): restore expected trace sampling to 0.1\". I'll add reviewers and the runbook snippet.

maria: great, will monitor canary and follow up. If we still see missing spans after the fix, we'll roll back the SDK bump.

jonas: once Canary is green I'll push the alert tweak. Good catch everyone.

li: thanks — bookmarking dash and logs links for post-mortem.

maria: closing loop here — feel free to DM if you see anything odd.
